This is going to be an unpopular post. 

Dogecoin is cancer in the crypto industry. 

Many people are going into crypto for the first time because they hear about celebrities promoting Dogecoin and they see the price going up.

Dogecoin was once a great project back in the early days of crypto but the devs had abandoned it.

The price resurgence which first started off as a joke and memed its way to the top, has grabbed the attention of many solid devs starting to build on it again.

I'm surprised Dogecoin hasn't gone up as much compared to some of the meme coins. 

It's the Bitcoin of memecoins.
